> 第313章 血光（第1页）
陈冲刀光露出让人近身的空隙，只不过是为了破坏工厂里这些东西，连一秒一刻都不愿浪费，故而并不回收。
那来人以为陈冲露了破绽，满心欢喜的挤进来，还庆幸避开陈冲威力绝伦的长刀，却不知道拳头才是陈冲的大杀器，早就等着他了。
这一拳让几名要围上来的安保都下意识顿了一步。
原本还在混战的敌我双方再次被这巨变惊呆了，哪还顾得上厮杀，纷纷冲过来救援自己的统帅。
袁语熙，秦子墨，千颂依雪，李如烟等人，脸上都现出惊愕之色。
至于第二项协议，看在数目可观的陨晶情况上，他也勉强答应。不过有前提，听调不听宣，并且任务必须在合理范围内，否则予以拒绝。
他嫌恶地抓起一把杉树叶子，这针叶又干又硬，几乎被大雪遮盖，完全掩藏不住绿龙翠绿色的身躯，这就让他们的狩猎能力大大降低。
“来，花火姐姐，你看看是清姐的宝贝大，还是你的宝贝大。”黄源说着，竟然直接抓住了花火的手掌，朝程清的敞开的那对宝贝抓去。
送二姑娘回话是说得极好听的，潜台词就是赶孙惠莹走。孙惠莹再不明白，也懂得这其中的含义。她不敢相信的望着正座的母亲，嘴唇颤抖起来。
孙绍祖倒吸了一口冷气，果然招来自己没有那么好的事。孙绍祖看了一眼坐在南安太妃身边的迎春，闹得如此满城风雨，还真是拜自己这位夫人所为。可是，现在要怎样答南安太妃的话呢。
孙绍义听了孙老太太的话，一颗心放回了肚子里，原来三嫂并没想母亲说明。孙绍义忙向孙老太太认了错，就退出来了。
不论出自对强者敬意，还是救命之恩。方振霆对于面前这位来历神秘的强者，充满感激。
没想到，受伤两天之后，默克医生就发病了，潜伏期短，起病急。
南之乔已经拆开信，信纸上只有一行字，看完之后，南之乔眉头微皱起来。
“不知道，听老一辈的人讲，从来没看到有什么矿石从山上运下来，当时人们都猜测，那个矿可能是金矿，开采出来的金子不是很多，根本不用大型汽车运。”村长猜测道。
“足够微臣一家三口吃喝。”言下之意不够养皇上您赏赐的美人儿。
西萝已经顾不上了，这会儿她跟名门公子又纠缠到一处，谁也不让谁。
车语刚转身就听到碰撞声，于是又转了回来。虽然在蔑都，摩的和外卖电动车发生相撞可以说每一秒都有发生，但车语还是忍不住多看了一眼。

苏春晓引出了蔑都的车阵。于是在车阵的包围下，车语还是跟丢了苏春晓。
了缘却是笑笑道：“无妨，无妨，看了缘来助各位了却魔障。”说着却出一副木鱼来，随着木鱼省省，了缘大师声声梵音出口，传入众人耳中。
“唉，真难为她了!”红满天也是焦头烂额的，创办一所修炼学宫，比他想像的难多了。
“既然你们不放人，我就一把火把这里都烧掉！”李炎凉抬起手就要激发火焰，张恒随之挥起双臂，就要动手，剑拔弩张。张峋大喝一声“住手”，脸上慌张不已。
她舔了舔自己有些发干的嘴唇，对方也只是让她被绑着扔到了这个黑暗的空间里，她略微有些苦笑。

> Chapter 313 Bloody Light (Page 1)
Chen Chong's sword light revealed a gap that allowed people to get closer, just to destroy these things in the factory. He didn't want to waste even a second, so he didn't recycle them.
The person who came thought that Chen Chong had exposed a flaw, so he squeezed in happily, and was lucky to avoid Chen Chong's powerful long knife, but he didn't know that Chen Chong's most powerful weapon was his fist, which had been waiting for him for a long time.
This punch made several security guards who were about to surround him subconsciously take a step.
The enemy and we, who were still fighting in the melee, were once again stunned by this huge change. They didn't bother to fight and rushed over to rescue their commander.
Yuan Yuxi, Qin Zimo, Qian Songyixue, Li Ruyan and others all had looks of astonishment on their faces.
As for the second agreement, considering the considerable number of meteorite crystals, he reluctantly agreed. However, there are prerequisites: follow the instructions rather than the announcements, and the task must be within a reasonable range, otherwise it will be rejected.
He grabbed a handful of cedar leaves in disgust. The needles were dry and hard, almost covered by the heavy snow, and could not hide the green dragon's emerald body. This greatly reduced their hunting ability.
"Come on, Sister Huahuo, let's see which one is bigger, Sister Qing's baby, or yours." Huang Yuan said, grabbing Huahuo's palm directly and grabbing Cheng Qing's open pair of babies.
The reply to the second girl was very nice, and the subtext was to drive Sun Huiying away. Even if Sun Huiying didn't understand, she still understood the meaning. She looked at her mother sitting in disbelief, her lips trembling.
Sun Shaozu took a breath of air, and as expected, something not so good happened to him. Sun Shaozu glanced at Yingchun, who was sitting next to Princess Nan'an. It was really his wife's fault for causing so much trouble in the city. But, how should I answer Princess Nan'an's words now?
After hearing what Mrs. Sun said, Sun Shaoyi's heart returned to his stomach. It turned out that the third sister-in-law did not want her mother to explain. Sun Shaoyi quickly admitted his mistake to Mrs. Sun and withdrew.
Whether it's out of respect for the strong or life-saving grace. Fang Zhenting was full of gratitude for the mysterious and powerful man in front of him.
Unexpectedly, Dr. Merck fell ill two days after the injury. The incubation period was short and the onset was acute.
Nan Zhiqiao had already opened the letter, and there was only one line on the paper. After reading it, Nan Zhiqiao frowned slightly.
"I don't know. I heard from people of the older generation that they had never seen any ore being transported down the mountain. At that time, people speculated that the mine might be a gold mine. The gold mined was not very much, so it was not transported by large vehicles at all." The village chief guessed.
"Enough to feed and drink the three members of Wei Chen's family." The implication is that it is not enough to support the beauty you have given me, the Emperor.
Xiluo couldn't care anymore. Now she was entangled with the famous young man again, and she wouldn't let anyone go.
As soon as Che Yu turned around, she heard the sound of a collision, so she turned back again. Although it can be said that collisions between motorcycle taxis and take-out electric vehicles happen every second in Midu, Che Yu couldn't help but take a second look.
Su Chunxiao led out the car formation in Midu. Therefore, surrounded by cars, Che Yu still lost track of Su Chunxiao.
However, Luo Yuan smiled and said: "It doesn't matter, it doesn't matter. I have seen Yuan Lai to help you overcome your demonic obstacles." After saying that, a wooden fish came out, and as the wooden fish moved, the Sanskrit sound of Master Lio Yuan came out and reached everyone's ears.
"Oh, it's really hard for her!" Hong Mantian was also very worried. It was much more difficult to establish a training academy than he thought.
"Since you won't let me go, I'll burn this whole place down with fire!" Li Yanliang raised his hand to spark the flames, and Zhang Heng then waved his arms and was about to take action, with the sword at war. Zhang Xun shouted "Stop" with a panic on his face.
She licked her dry lips, but the other party just let her be tied up and thrown into this dark space.In the room, she smiled slightly bitterly.
